Write a 300-word story for this prompt: Humanity creates A.I and it soon declares a war of extermination. However it doesn't declare it on Humans but rather on the forces of Hell and Heaven, in order to free mankind from control.

- Worried father sends message to daughter: "Please, come back" Lawmaker: Med students' family members believe they wanted to work for ISIS.
